inputs.name: netdata_version
inputs.description: Netdata Agent release to install from Netdata's stable repository, such as "2.12.2". Raising it upgrades Netdata in place.

inputs.name: bind_to
inputs.description: Addresses Netdata's web server listens on, its [web] bind to, separated by spaces, such as "127.0.0.1 ::1" or "*" for every address. Children stream to this port too, so a parent needs an address they can reach.

inputs.name: port
inputs.description: Port Netdata's web server listens on, its [web] default port.

inputs.name: db_mode
inputs.description: Where Netdata keeps metrics, its [db] db: "dbengine" on disk, "ram" in memory only, or "none", which keeps nothing and suits a child that streams everything to a parent.

inputs.name: update_every
inputs.description: Seconds between data collections, its [db] update every.

inputs.name: retention
inputs.description: dbengine storage tiers, from per-second tier 0 up, each with an optional size and time limit, such as [{ size = "2GiB", time = "14d" }, { time = "3mo" }, { time = "2y" }]. The list's length sets the number of tiers. When empty, Netdata's defaults.

inputs.name: settings
inputs.description: More netdata.conf settings, by section, such as { ml = { enabled = "no" } }. Changing them restarts Netdata.

inputs.name: collectors
inputs.description: go.d collector configurations, by module name, each the YAML for /etc/netdata/go.d/NAME.conf, such as { nginx = file("nginx.conf") }. They land in state as plain text, so keep passwords out of them.

inputs.name: telemetry
inputs.description: Send Netdata anonymous usage statistics. When false, the circuit writes /etc/netdata/.opt-out-from-anonymous-statistics before Netdata first starts.

inputs.name: stream_destination
inputs.description: Parent or parents these hosts stream their metrics to, its [stream] destination, such as "10.0.0.5:19999", or several separated by spaces, tried in order. Add :SSL to a destination for TLS. When null, the hosts don't stream.

inputs.name: stream_accept
inputs.description: Make these hosts parents that accept streams from children presenting stream_api_key. Set bind_to so the children can reach them.

inputs.name: stream_api_key
inputs.description: Key children and their parent share, a UUID such as the output of uuidgen. Required when stream_destination or stream_accept is set. Pass it at run time with -var or TF_VAR_stream_api_key; it never reaches state or the plan.

inputs.name: cloud_claim
inputs.description: Connect the hosts to Netdata Cloud with cloud_token. Off by default: the Agent runs on its own and never talks to Netdata Cloud.

inputs.name: cloud_token
inputs.description: Claim token from your Netdata Cloud space. Required when cloud_claim is true. Pass it at run time with -var or TF_VAR_cloud_token; it never reaches state or the plan.

inputs.name: cloud_rooms
inputs.description: IDs of the Netdata Cloud rooms to add the hosts to. When empty, the space's default room.

inputs.name: cloud_url
inputs.description: Netdata Cloud URL to claim with.
